policies.hardware_scope: Only assembled STEPPERONLINE 24/36 V Hall BLDC motors at <= USD 50; only the user's three 30:1 reducers on their specified joints.
policies.motor_rating: Published continuous torque from rest through published rated rpm is assumed; no extrapolation above rated speed. No measured stall thermal map.
policies.motor_rotor_inertia: Published rotor inertia remains null if unavailable. Simulation uses the explicit upper bound I <= M_motor * R_envelope^2, treating all motor mass at the envelope radius. This is a conservative bound, not a manufacturer rotor-inertia specification.
policies.motor_mass: Complete assembled motor net mass. Drivers, encoders, wiring and custom shaft adapters are not assigned invented masses.
policies.motor_geometry: Published body length; conservative circular radius encloses round body or square flange diagonal. Front/rear shaft dimensions are retained in source facts; exact reducer-specific shaft insertion/coupling requires mechanical design.
policies.reducer_geometry: Exact manufacturer model-specific drawings. CS-11-2XH-A uses nominal diameter 58 mm bounding flange circle and 32 mm axial envelope; generic 82.5 mm page summary is retained as a discrepancy.
policies.reducer_rating: Published rated output torque at 2000 input rpm; evaluation restricted to <=2000 input rpm. Repeated/momentary peaks are stored, not used to increase continuous capacity.
policies.unpublished_reducer_input_torque: Unknown; output limits enforced, separate input-shaft constraint remains unverified.
policies.transmission: Ideal lossless reducer and 1:1 local input belts, as in the existing optimization protocol. Published efficiency, friction and backdrive data unavailable; no 75% efficiency is silently substituted.
policies.electrical_objective: Pmax is a mechanical rating-limited objective. Voltage/current are retained; electrical current, copper loss and common-bus selection are not optimized. Mixed nominal voltages require suitable supplies/drives.
policies.geometry_and_mass: Approved base edge-frame/mount topology with unchanged local assembly gates and geometry-derived structural mass/CoM/inertia. L2 fixed 90 mm. Common J5-to-J6 spacing 110 mm (previous 70 mm) accommodates complete framed J6 motors; existing belt frames widen to clear motor rear bodies. The remaining links compensate to preserve exactly 550 mm reach. Unlimited joints; global self-collision checks off by user request.

reducer_sources.purpose: Strict user-selected 30:1 reducer palette for the 0.5 kg fast-arm study. No substitute models or ratios.

reducers.name: SITO HD-14 30:1 (user-selected; drawing-verified nominal envelope)
reducers.geometry_envelope_status: Exact model-specific manufacturer drawing visually inspected; nominal dimensions, excluding a custom motor adapter.
reducers.inertia_reference: Shaft side not explicitly established in inspected manufacturer sources; do not reflect it through the ratio.
reducers.source_rating_check: Fresh manufacturer HTML and retained byte-verified current catalog agree on the selected 30:1 torque/speed ratings.
interface_notes: Nominal total axial stack 17.50 mm; another drawing dimension is 15.50 mm, with 11.7 mm internal reference depth.
Drawing annotates central diameter 11H7 and 20 mm internal clearance. A motor shaft adapter/coupler is required; do not assume a direct 8 mm shaft fit.
Drawing calls out eight 3.4 mm through holes on diameter 64 mm pattern and output-side M3 fastener patterns.
Output bearing load/stiffness ratings were not established by these product drawings.
Undimensioned fastener heads are not treated as a newly invented additional case length.

reducers.name: SITO CD-20 30:1 (user-selected; drawing-verified nominal envelope)
reducers.geometry_envelope_status: Exact model-specific manufacturer drawing visually inspected; nominal dimensions, excluding a custom motor adapter.
reducers.inertia_reference: Shaft side not explicitly established in inspected manufacturer sources; do not reflect it through the ratio.
reducers.source_rating_check: Fresh manufacturer HTML and retained byte-verified current catalog agree on the selected 30:1 torque/speed ratings.
interface_notes: 29.70 mm total axial envelope includes the 2.50 mm difference relative to the 27.20 mm main body dimension.
Drawing annotates coaxial bore diameters 16H7, 18H7 and 20H7; input/output roles need assembly/interface review.
An 8 mm motor shaft does not directly fill the larger annotated bores; a reducer-specific hub/coupler is required.
Drawing output fasteners include eight M6 holes depth 12 mm on diameter 34 mm; outer mounting pattern has twelve diameter 3.4 mm through holes on diameter 64 mm.

reducers.name: SITO CS-11-2XH-A 30:1 (user-selected; drawing-verified nominal envelope)
reducers.geometry_envelope_status: Exact model-specific manufacturer drawing visually inspected; nominal dimensions, excluding a custom motor adapter.
reducers.inertia_reference: Shaft side not explicitly established in inspected manufacturer sources; do not reflect it through the ratio.
reducers.source_rating_check: Fresh manufacturer HTML and retained byte-verified current catalog agree on the selected 30:1 torque/speed ratings.
interface_notes: Catalog explicitly identifies this exact 2XH-A variant as input hole and output flange; do not substitute the 2XH-B output-shaft variant.
Catalog direction arrows identify input at the left-side diameter 5 mm hole and output at the opposite end of the long body.
Nominal total axial envelope is 32 mm: 2 mm input projection plus 30 mm from square mounting-flange face to the opposite output face.
Fixed flange is a chamfered 43 mm square, with an explicitly annotated diameter 58 mm circumscribed envelope. The cylindrical body diameter is 40.5 mm; diameter 40 mm is another pilot/end feature.
A conservative circular rendering uses radius 29 mm to encompass the flange corners; treating 43 mm square width as a 43 mm circular diameter would underestimate occupied space.

Input bore diameter 5 +0.015/0 mm has 11.60 mm annotated depth and 2-M3 radial fasteners; this is a nominal match to a 5 mm motor shaft, subject to tolerances, usable insertion depth and radial shaft support.
Opposite output-end drawing annotations include diameter 12 +0.02/0 mm and diameter 26 mm.

Product HTML family summary says thickness <=82.5 mm, while manufacturer catalog family summary says <=40 mm. The exact model-specific drawing dimension 32 mm resolves the arm-envelope choice; both inconsistent summaries are retained below.
Do not infer the internal split of stationary and rotating reducer mass from these envelope dimensions; that split is unpublished.

retained_source_discrepancy.specific_drawing_resolution: 43 mm is square flange width, not circular outer envelope; use nominal 58 mm circumscribed flange diameter and 32 mm total axial stack from the exact 2XH-A drawing.

manufacturer_catalog.note: Freshly downloaded catalog is byte-identical to the retained manufacturer catalog; reuse that immutable source copy.

reducer_sources.unknown_fields_policy: Unpublished input torque, efficiency, backdrive torque, rotating-inertia shaft reference and output-bearing load limits stay null. Repeated/momentary peak ratings are not continuous ratings.
reducer_sources.geometry_policy: Use exact model-specific nominal drawing envelopes. Preserve the square CS11 flange corners through a conservative 58 mm circular bound when the existing model requires cylindrical envelopes. Do not silently shrink geometry to make a design fit.
reducer_sources.mass_policy: Use the manufacturer published upper mass bound per entire reducer; moving/stationary mass partition remains unverified. Motor adapters, shaft couplers, encoders and support stock are separate model components.
